name: OnTheEvening_2
short_caption: The robot extends both arms outward in a welcoming, inclusive gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly raises both arms forward and slightly upward while rotating its palms outward. The hands open wide and sweep out to the sides, creating a welcoming and expansive posture. After a brief pause at maximum extension, the robot smoothly retracts both arms back to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The robot sweeps both arms outward to its sides; ensure a clear safety zone of about 0.5 meters on both left and right sides of the robot.
